decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch that builds directly on the established portfolio and is still shown on the website in 2024, management is likely to justify the invested development effort and keep it unless clear persistent failure becomes undeniable.

Its own product page across 2023 and 2024 signals visible public commitment, and as a close-to-core injection product management is likely to continue backing it rather than admit the launch was premature.

Because it extends the firm's existing pump business and explicitly reuses proven air-motor technology, disappointing outcomes can still be framed as temporary while sunk engineering effort favors continuation.

This product has sustained standalone presentation and fits the firm's announced move toward more future-oriented and interoperable solutions, making withdrawal especially costly in terms of justification and reputation.

Although only launched in 2024 and not heavily publicized yet, it is very close to the core offer and still early enough for management to attribute any weak uptake to normal market introduction effects rather than terminate it.
